defense_news.title: Ford in talks with the Pentagon to supply military vehicles
defense_news.summary: Ford said on Tuesday it has held talks with the Pentagon about supplying military vehicles and other defense products to the U.S. military.

defense_news.title: Coast Guard tests capabilities of new icebreaker with 5-month Arctic mission
defense_news.summary: U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Storis, the first new American icebreaker in decades, returned from its maiden voyage recently with a list of lessons learned for future missions.

defense_news.title: ‘A new competition space’: US Coast Guard takes icebreaker on maiden voyage to the Arctic
defense_news.summary: Having a more capable icebreaking ship represents a mission paradigm shift for the U.S. Coast Guard, said the captain of the new cutter.
